intelligence.essence: The top bar he likes is the Old Way: the logo on one side and her picture on the other, both big enough to actually see. "NAYA" sits beside her picture, never underneath it. Less glow in the middle, lit up, elegant and pro — she is the headliner of the show, the way the certificate's picture lights up like a real live show.
intelligence.simple_view: The bar at the top has her picture and the logo, both big, so you can really see her face. Her name sits next to her picture, not under it. It glows softly, like the curtain going up on a show, and she is the star of it.
intelligence.grandma_view: Think of the top of the page like the top of a theatre stage. Her picture is large and clear, her name beside it, the little N logo shining on the other side. It feels alive and grand, not small and dim — you can see her smile the moment the page opens.
